samples.summary: `api-keys revoke`/`create` still ignore `--dry-run` and execute the mutation
samples.evidence: This change adds `opts.dryRun` short-circuits to read commands, but `registerApiKeysCommand` has no `dryRun` check at all: `api-keys create <name>` (api-keys.ts:17 → `createApiKey`) and `api-keys revoke <key-id>` (api-keys.ts:45 → `revokeApiKey`, a DELETE) run the real request under `--dry-run`. A user (or agent) previewing `wafflebase api-keys revoke k-1 --dry-run` irreversibly revokes the key, even though the global flag is documented as 'Show request without executing' (root.ts:75) and docs/design/cli.md advertises dry-run as a first-class agent affordance. A grep for `dryRun` across packages/cli/src returns zero hits in api-keys.ts.
searchedFor: Grep 'dryRun' in packages/cli/src (no hits in commands/api-keys.ts)

samples.summary: The same `--dry-run`-still-fetches bug is left unfixed in notes/slides/files read commands
samples.evidence: The change fixes `docs list`, `docs get`, `tabs list` and `cells get`, but identical read commands elsewhere still hit the network under `--dry-run`: `notes get` (notes.ts:76 `getDocument`), `notes list` (notes.ts:35 `listDocuments`), `slides get` (slides.ts:81), `slides list` (slides.ts:40), `files list` (files.ts:85) and `files get` (files.ts:105). Each of these has no `opts.dryRun` branch, so `--dry-run` performs the very request it promises not to send — the same behavior this PR describes as a bug (burnt rate limit, access-log entry). The fix is partial and leaves the flag's semantics inconsistent across sibling namespaces.

samples.summary: Adding push/main env makes the empty-string fall-through assertion vacuous
samples.evidence: `resolve()` returns `FULL("push to main …")` at scripts/changed-areas.mjs:530 for `GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push` + `GITHUB_REF_NAME=main`, which is checked immediately after the falsy `WAFFLEBASE_CHANGED_AREAS` branch at line 510. With those two vars now set, the test's `out.full === true` and the new `/push to main/` match are satisfied entirely by the deploy-gate rule, so the case the test names (an empty `WAFFLEBASE_CHANGED_AREAS` must not silently select zero lanes) is no longer exercised at all — a regression in that guard would still pass. The intent of removing repo-state dependence is sound, but the empty-string behavior now needs a distinct assertion (e.g. same env with and without the empty string, on a non-main ref, using a stubbed repo root).

finding.summary: `api-keys revoke`/`create` still ignore `--dry-run` and execute the mutation
finding.evidence: This change adds `opts.dryRun` short-circuits to read commands, but `registerApiKeysCommand` has no `dryRun` check at all: `api-keys create <name>` (api-keys.ts:17 → `createApiKey`) and `api-keys revoke <key-id>` (api-keys.ts:45 → `revokeApiKey`, a DELETE) run the real request under `--dry-run`. A user (or agent) previewing `wafflebase api-keys revoke k-1 --dry-run` irreversibly revokes the key, even though the global flag is documented as 'Show request without executing' (root.ts:75) and docs/design/cli.md advertises dry-run as a first-class agent affordance. A grep for `dryRun` across packages/cli/src returns zero hits in api-keys.ts.
searchedFor: Grep 'dryRun' in packages/cli/src (no hits in commands/api-keys.ts)

verdict.reason: The absence claim is accurate. `registerApiKeysCommand` reads global opts (api-keys.ts:15,29,43) but never branches on `opts.dryRun`; `create` (api-keys.ts:17) and `revoke` (api-keys.ts:45) call the client unconditionally. The `--dry-run` flag is registered globally (root.ts:75, GlobalOpts.dryRun at root.ts:21) and is surfaced to these actions via optsWithGlobals (root.ts:24-27), so it parses and is silently ignored. I searched for an indirect guard and found none: cli.ts:17-33 registers namespaces with no preAction hook; runCli (cli.ts:71-92) only envelopes errors; HttpClient has no dryRun awareness — createApiKey (http-client.ts:372-382) issues a real POST and revokeApiKey (http-client.ts:383-389) a real DELETE via fetch; schema/registry.ts contains no 'dry' reference; and an unlimited grep of packages/cli/src for dryRun|dry_run|dry-run|printDryRun yields hits in cells.ts, tabs.ts, docs.ts, notes.ts, slides.ts, files.ts, sheets-import.ts, root.ts and the importers but zero in api-keys.ts or http-client.ts. Every peer destructive command does guard (docs.ts:161, notes.ts:107, slides.ts:112, files.ts:136), confirming the intended contract. Result: `wafflebase api-keys revoke <id> --dry-run` irreversibly revokes the key — a missing-guard / data-loss correctness defect on a real path.

searchedFor: Grep 'dryRun' across packages/cli/src to enumerate commands with/without the guard
Read packages/cli/src/commands/notes.ts, slides.ts (lines 20-150), files.ts in full

verdict.reason: The absence claim holds. `notes list` (notes.ts:35), `notes get` (notes.ts:76), `slides list` (slides.ts:40), `slides get` (slides.ts:81), `files list` (files.ts:85) and `files get` (files.ts:105) all call `getClient(opts).listDocuments()/getDocument()` with no `opts.dryRun` branch, while their sibling subcommands in the very same files do guard (notes.ts:55/89/107/135/195, slides.ts:60/94/112/141/197, files.ts:58/118/136). I looked for an indirect/central guard and found none: `getClient` (root.ts:38-40) merely constructs `HttpClient`; `HttpClient.request` (http-client.ts:166-186) and `listDocuments`/`getDocument` (http-client.ts:189-200) call `fetch` unconditionally with no dry-run awareness; `printDryRun` (client/dry-run.ts:6-25) is a pure printer requiring an explicit call; `buildProgram` (cli.ts:17-33) adds no wrapper; and a grep for `preAction|hook(` across packages/cli/src returns nothing, so no commander middleware short-circuits these actions. The global `--dry-run` flag is registered on the root program (root.ts:75), so every one of these commands accepts it, and docs/design/cli.md:809-810 documents it as "prints the request that would be sent — without executing it". Consequently `wafflebase notes get X --dry-run` issues the GET it promises not to send. This is a missing-guard/wrong-behavior defect in the correctness lane; impact is major (read-only request, so no crash or data loss, but the flag's documented contract is broken and the fix is inconsistent across sibling namespaces). Supporting evidence that the fix is partial rather than delegated elsewhere: docs/design/cli.md:824-827 enumerates only the four fixed commands, and packages/cli/test/read-dry-run.test.ts covers only docs list/get and sheets cells get.
